[commandlist\texfx\run_cos]
  local $pi = 3.14159265
  if $cos_in == inf || $cos_in == -inf || $cos_in == nan || $cos_in == null
  $cos_out = nan
  else
  local $x = ($cos_in+$pi/2)%$pi-$pi/2
  local $xx = $x*$x
  local $f0 = -($xx/2)
  local $f1 = (($xx*$xx)/24)
  local $f2 = -(($xx*$xx*$xx)/720)
  local $f3 = (($xx*$xx*$xx*$xx)/40320)
  local $f4 = -(($xx*$xx*$xx*$xx*$xx)/3628800)
  $cos_out = -((($cos_in+$pi/2)/$pi)%2//1*2-1) * (1+$f0+$f1+$f2+$f3+$f4)
  endif
  $cos_in = 0

[commandlist\texfx\run_cos]
  local $pi = 3.14159265
  if $cos_in == inf || $cos_in == -inf || $cos_in == nan || $cos_in == null
  $cos_out = nan
  else
  local $x = ($cos_in+$pi/2)%$pi-$pi/2
  local $xx = $x*$x
  local $f0 = -($xx/2)
  local $f1 = (($xx*$xx)/24)
  local $f2 = -(($xx*$xx*$xx)/720)
  local $f3 = (($xx*$xx*$xx*$xx)/40320)
  local $f4 = -(($xx*$xx*$xx*$xx*$xx)/3628800)
  $cos_out = -((($cos_in+$pi/2)/$pi)%2//1*2-1) * (1+$f0+$f1+$f2+$f3+$f4)
  endif
  $cos_in = 0

[customshader\mods\- nefer weapon (reliquary of truth)\reliquaryoftruth.ini\rotate]
  cs=Rotate.hlsl
  local $x = x
  local $y = y
  local $z = z
  local $w = w
  local $x1 = x1
  local $y1 = y1
  local $z1 = z1
  x = $x_rot
  y = $y_rot
  z = $z_rot
  w = $_2
  x1 = $x_off
  y1 = $y_off
  z1 = $z_off
  run = builtincommandlistunbindallrendertargets
  $_1 = $_1 // 1
  if $_1 > 0
  dispatch = $_1//1, 1, 1
  endif
  x = $x
  y = $y
  z = $z
  w = $w
  x1 = $x1
  y1 = $y1
  z1 = $z1
  $_1 = 0

[commandlist\texfx\run_cos]
  local $pi = 3.14159265
  if $cos_in == inf || $cos_in == -inf || $cos_in == nan || $cos_in == null
  $cos_out = nan
  else
  local $x = ($cos_in+$pi/2)%$pi-$pi/2
  local $xx = $x*$x
  local $f0 = -($xx/2)
  local $f1 = (($xx*$xx)/24)
  local $f2 = -(($xx*$xx*$xx)/720)
  local $f3 = (($xx*$xx*$xx*$xx)/40320)
  local $f4 = -(($xx*$xx*$xx*$xx*$xx)/3628800)
  $cos_out = -((($cos_in+$pi/2)/$pi)%2//1*2-1) * (1+$f0+$f1+$f2+$f3+$f4)
  endif
  $cos_in = 0
